description: This file defines the ProductMixRepository interface for accessing ProductMix entities in a JPA-based data persistence layer within the Fineract project. It includes custom query methods to retrieve product mix data based on product IDs and restricted product IDs.

classes.name: ProductMixRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for ProductMix entity providing CRUD and custom query methods.

methods.name: findByProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductMix entities associated with a specific product ID.

methods.name: findRestrictedProductIdsByProductId
methods.description: Fetches a list of restricted product IDs associated with a given product ID.

methods.name: findRestrictedProducts
methods.description: Returns a list of ProductMix entities that are restricted products based on the restrictedProduct ID.
